maddeler.e: سَذَاب or سُذَاب • (saḏāb or suḏāb) m
maddeler.t: From Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (stʾp /⁠saẟāb⁠/) (now Persian سداب (sadâb, sodâb); during latest Middle Persian and earliest New Persian /d/ was spirantized in the accents Arabic acquired its borrowings from). From the same source is Classical Syriac ܣܕܒ (/⁠*səḏāḇ⁠/).
